name: smwgraphics-super-metroid-rinka-and-rinka-block
title: Super Metroid - Rinka and Rinka Block
description:
When I was viewing and thinking about this custom sprite that Koopster made, I'm surprised that nobody has submitting the Rinka sprite and Rinka's block graphics on this site before so I decided to rip these graphics.

Rip to work for this custom sprite.

Important: Make sure you change the trackingflame.json palette slot to F to make the sprite display the palette correctly.
